facts.value: Tests this exact sequence: ftCo_SpecialS_CheckInput; ftCo_Attack100_CheckInput, whose body dispatches up special; ftCo_800D6824, neutral special; ftCo_800D68C0, down special; Catch; AttackS4, AttackHi4, AttackLw4; AttackS3, AttackHi3, AttackLw3; Attack1; ftCo_80099794; ftCo_80091A4C; ftFx_AppealS_CheckInput; ftCo_800DE9D8; Jump; Dash; ftCo_800D5FB0, squat; Turn; Walk. The first true result returns immediately and suppresses later checks; if all return false, this invocation performs no accepted transition.
facts.rationale: The canonical Attack100_CheckInput name is misleading: its body calls ftData_SpecialHi, not a rapid-jab entry.

evidence.why: Address-named predicates dispatch neutral/down specials; misleading Attack100 name dispatches up special.
Squat threshold and entry behind address-named predicate.

facts.value: Forwards the Wait fighter object to ft_80084F3C and then ftColl_8007AEE0. The first helper selects ground friction, scaling it above walk_max_vel, and stores friction as primary ground acceleration before projecting ground movement. It does not directly subtract from gr_vel; the shared fighter update later integrates pending acceleration. The second helper clears shield_hit.skip_update_pos.
facts.rationale: Distinguish queued acceleration from immediate velocity mutation and identify the actual followup flag write.

evidence.why: Friction/movement helper precedes ftColl flag update.
Friction writes primary ground acceleration rather than directly changing gr_vel.
Subsequent integration adds pending accelerations and clears them.
